Various geometric distributions are shown in the visualisation below, for different values of\ $p$.



```{r, GeometricDemo, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Geometric distributions."}
library(plotly)

# --- Parameters ---
ps <- c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8)   # Different success probabilities
x_max <- 20              # Max x to display

x <- 0:x_max

# --- Create figure ---
fig <- plot_ly(width = 700, height = 450)

# Add all traces (PMFs), first trace visible by default
for(i in seq_along(ps)){
  p <- ps[i]
  y <- dgeom(x, prob = p)
  
  fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
    x = x,
    y = y,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    line = list(color = "steelblue", width = 2, dash = "dash"),
    marker = list(size = 8),
    visible = ifelse(i == 1, TRUE, FALSE),  # FIRST trace visible
    name = paste0("p=", p),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Find global y-axis max ---
y_max <- max(sapply(ps, function(p) max(dgeom(x, prob = p)))) * 1.1

# --- Create buttons ---
buttons <- list()
for(i in seq_along(ps)){
  vis <- rep(FALSE, length(ps))
  vis[i] <- TRUE
  
  mean_val <- (1 - ps[i]) / ps[i]
  var_val  <- (1 - ps[i]) / ps[i]^2
  
  buttons[[i]] <- list(
    method = "update",
    args = list(
      list(visible = vis),
      list(
        title = paste0("Geometric PMF: p=", ps[i]),
        annotations = list(
          list(
            x = 0.95, y = 0.95,
            xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
            text = paste0("mean=", round(mean_val,2),
                          "<br>var=", round(var_val,2)),
            showarrow = FALSE,
            xanchor = "right", yanchor = "top",
            font = list(size = 12, color = "black")
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    label = paste0("p=", ps[i])
  )
}

# --- Layout ---
fig <- fig %>% layout(
  title = list(text = "Geometric Distribution PMF", x = 0.5),
  xaxis = list(title = "x", range = c(0, x_max)),
  yaxis = list(title = "PMF", range = c(0, y_max)),  # fixed
  updatemenus = list(
    list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.2,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = buttons
    )
  )
)

fig
```
